slides.title: Insulin: the first peptide to become a medicine
slides.text: Before it, type 1 diabetes was a death sentence 👉

slides.title: Banting and Best
slides.text: They isolated insulin from the pancreas. Less than a year later the first patient got an injection.

slides.title: 14-year-old Leonard Thompson
slides.text: He was critically ill. After purified insulin his condition improved markedly. He was the first person treated with insulin.
The prize went to Banting and Macleod. Banting shared it with Best, and Macleod with Collip.
